topography.project_purpose: Leveraged Farming. Structurally: 69 project-authored contract(s) across 3 chain(s); 7 ERC4626 vaults, 15 ERC20 tokens, 5 Chainlink feeds; role-gated via AccessControl; upgradeable via ERC1967/UUPS proxies; built on openzeppelin.
topography.relationship_narrative: The protocol comprises 3 functional families. Its contracts share 22 common project-authored base contract(s) (origamielevatedaccess, origamielevatedaccessbase, origamimanagerpausable). Dominant framework: openzeppelin.
